reason: Godot opens plugin.cfg from the project and loads plugin.gd at editor startup. Replacing the project plugin changes the registered dock and its field declarations on the same editor executable.
host_contract: The project enables res://addons/project_brief/plugin.cfg. Its tool script must extend EditorPlugin. It registers an EditorDock with add_dock and declares read or replace_text modes in workbench_fields.
rollback: Restore the previously verified plugin.cfg and plugin.gd in the project and reopen the editor. The dock again publishes the previous field modes. The project summary remains in editor project metadata.
